text: The door of {place} is on the latch and the step has been wet a while.
Two and four is the hour {place} belongs to whoever is still in it.
Cold came in behind me at {place} and took the good chair.
There is grey at the bottom of the sky over {place}, and nothing open yet.
The fog off the river has {place} down to the near kerb and no further.
Gratings are going back at {place} and the first of the day is going to work past me.
{place} at six in the morning is a public room with private hours behind it.
The stairs up to {place} have been swept and the landing has not.
Somebody is always coming out of {place} as I am going in, and never the same somebody.
